meta.homeTitle: Coded — The world is the classroom
meta.homeDescription: International STEAM programs for students aged 11–17 in Orlando, the UK and Tokyo.

hero.headline: The world is the classroom. Your project is the future.
hero.sub: International programs for students aged 11–17 in Orlando, the UK and Tokyo: expert-led workshops, real projects and a final project presentation.

method.title: Four steps, from classroom to project

experts.title: Expert delivered
experts.body: Classes are led by specialists who work in what they teach.

workshops.title: Live workshops
workshops.body: Students learn by doing, in the places where technology actually happens.

projects.title: Project-based learning
projects.body: Every team designs a solution to a real challenge and defends it at the end.

coding.title: Coding
coding.body: Code ties it all together: from idea to working prototype.

skills.title: What they bring back home
skills.sdg: Every project picks at least one of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

championship.title: From your classroom to Tokyo.
championship.body: The top 20 winning schools from past leagues prepare for six months and present their project in Tokyo. The winning team gets a cash prize and Coded's support to make it real.

trust.title: They travel far. Never alone.

guardian.title: A Guardian for every student
guardian.body: Each student has a personal Guardian who shares updates and photos with the family every day.

doctor.title: On-site doctor
doctor.body: On-site medical care and arrangements with local healthcare providers.

insurance.title: Health insurance
insurance.body: Every student travels with health insurance included.

app.title: 360 navigation app
app.body: Families can follow the program's journey from the app.

staff.title: 24/7 staff at the residence
staff.body: Passcode or keypass access and on-site staff around the clock.

trust.sellerOfTravel: Florida Seller of Travel · Registration No. ST46325
trust.stemOrg: STEM.org recognitions: “STEM Educational Program” and “Best in STEM”

cta.title: Ready for the next project?
cta.body: Tell us whether you're a school, a family or a student and we'll help you pick the right program.
